subtle believable wall-paint microtexture without visible noise blotches

visual_target: A source-matched, plain painted drywall finish for the reconstructed human room. Keep the walls architecturally plain: the photograph shows painted wall surfaces, stained wood baseboards and crown, and separate window casing. Do not invent paneling, wallpaper, built-ins, trim, or decorative features. Preserve every RoomDefinition wall segment, opening, dimension, and cutaway.
